rooms.1: A tropical beach by a deep blue ocean under a bright sky with small clouds; a giant weathered carved stone head, like an Easter Island moai, rises half-buried in the sand at the centre; the dense green edge of an impenetrable jungle crowds in on the right.
rooms.2: A tropical beach by a deep blue ocean; at the west (right) end a towering red-rock cliff rises sheer from the sand toward the sky.
rooms.3: The edge of a hot, sun-baked rocky cliff on the outside slope of an EXTINCT volcano (no smoke, no fire, no lava, no eruption): cracked dark red and black rock radiating heat shimmer, a narrow dark crevice splitting the rock face, the sea and sky far below and beyond.
rooms.4: A tropical beach by a deep blue ocean with a cluster of tall palm trees leaning over the sand.
rooms.5: A shallow rocky tidepool on a tropical shore: clear blue water cupped in golden sand and rock, the open ocean beyond.
rooms.6: On the rim of an extinct volcano looking down into its vast crater: sheer ochre crater walls falling to a turquoise lake far below, jagged rim in the foreground, yellow ridges beyond under a bright sky.
rooms.7: A large open plain of yellow grass and sand; across it a huge red extinct volcano with a flat top rises against the bright sky, sand-coloured ridges either side.
rooms.8: Inside the crater of an extinct volcano: steep ochre walls streaked with red all around, a still blue lake filling the floor, and the dark mouth of a cave low in the crater wall.
rooms.9: A long tunnel lined with riveted pale-blue metal panels in a grid, a white floor converging in perspective to a dark doorway at the far end, an alien, futuristic feel.
rooms.10: Standing on top of a giant carved stone head on a beach, looking out over the open ocean; far offshore a low sandy atoll lies on the horizon, sea birds overhead.
rooms.11: A deep, dark cave in the volcano wall: rough rock, a natural stone basin of water, scattered fish bones on the floor, a dark opening in the rock.
rooms.12: A crater lake seen from its surface: blue water in the foreground, steep ochre volcano walls rising all around it with streaks of red, a thin bright strip of sky at the top.
rooms.13: Underwater, just above the bottom of a volcanic crater lake: blue-green water, rocks and weeds on the lake bed, shafts of light from the surface far above.
rooms.14: Afloat on a crude red wooden raft on a blue lake, the raft's planks running away from the viewer, splashes of white water either side, steep crater walls beyond.
rooms.15: A small, low sandy atoll in a vast deep blue ocean under a bright sky with clouds and a few sea birds; the main island a dark line on the far horizon.
rooms.16: A beach by the ocean beneath a steep cliff; a dark cave opening in the cliff face above the sand.
rooms.17: An ancient cave: rough brown rock walls covered with primitive cave drawings of animals and figures in ochre and black, stalactites hanging from the roof, a dark opening in the roof above.
rooms.18: A small secluded ledge on the inner wall of an EXTINCT volcano (no smoke, no fire, no eruption), west of a crater lake: a narrow rock shelf, a narrow crevice in the rock wall behind it, the still blue lake below, the crater rim against a clear sky.
rooms.19: In the top of a tall palm tree: big green fronds all around and coconuts in the crown, a beach and the blue ocean far below and beyond.
rooms.20: A gleaming alien metal room of riveted pale panels, softly lit, with a sealed glass display case on a pedestal in the middle.
rooms.21: A gleaming alien metal room of riveted pale panels with a blue tint, softly lit, with a sealed glass display case on a pedestal against the far wall.
rooms.22: A long tunnel lined with riveted pale-blue metal panels, branching: openings to the right and left, the white floor converging to a dark doorway ahead, alien and futuristic.
rooms.23: A dimly lit room of rough volcanic rock, faint light from somewhere unseen, an opening to one side.
rooms.24: A room of rough volcanic rock filled with strange alien machinery: glowing panels, pipes and humming metal shapes set into the rock.
rooms.25: A maze of narrow twisting rock caves, passages leading off in every direction into darkness, dim light.
rooms.29: A gleaming alien metal room with a shimmering blue force field across one side and a control console of glowing buttons and screens against the wall.
rooms.30: A small, bare metal room of riveted pale panels, alien and futuristic, softly lit.
rooms.32: The edge of a crumbling sandy cliff on the outside slope of an EXTINCT volcano (no smoke, no fire, no eruption): yellow sand and rock dropping away steeply to the ocean, a clear blue sky.
rooms.34: Death: a menacing scene of doom on a savage island — a looming shadow over a skull in the sand, red sky, ominous and final.
